# OAKA Residences @ Bukit Jalil (www.oakaresidence.my)

> Landing page for OAKA Residences, a freehold low-density development by Berjaya Land Berhad in Bukit Jalil, Kuala Lumpur. Run by licensed real estate negotiator Yee Woei Shyan (REN 46305), IQI Realty Sdn Bhd. Not the developer's website. Prices follow the developer's price list; ask for the current list.

## Project facts
- Developer: Berjaya Land Berhad
- Location: Bukit Jalil, Kuala Lumpur; near Pavilion Bukit Jalil, Bukit Jalil Golf & Country Resort and Bukit Jalil Recreational Park; IMU and APU nearby
- Tenure: freehold; residential land title
- Scale: about 350 units (low density) on about 2.2 acres
- Layouts: Type A about 882 sq ft (2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms); Type B about 1,175–1,182 sq ft (2+1 bedrooms); Type C about 1,423 sq ft (3 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms)
- Estimated completion: 2028
- Facilities: infinity pool, sky garden and rooftop lounge, gym and yoga studio, half basketball court, children's playground, private theatre room; GreenRE Gold certified; pet-friendly; EV charging
- Access: KESAS, MEX and KL–Seremban highways; LRT stations within about 3 km

## FAQ
- Where is OAKA Residences located? OAKA Residences is in Bukit Jalil, Kuala Lumpur, near Pavilion Bukit Jalil, Bukit Jalil Golf & Country Resort and Bukit Jalil Recreational Park, with direct access to the KESAS, MEX and KL–Seremban highways and LRT stations within about 3 km.
- Who is the developer of OAKA Residences? OAKA Residences is developed by Berjaya Land Berhad.
- Is OAKA Residences freehold or leasehold? OAKA Residences is a freehold development on a residential title.
- How many units are there and how big is the land? OAKA Residences is a low-density development of about 350 units on roughly 2.2 acres of land.
- What unit layouts and sizes are available? Three layouts are offered: Type A of about 882 sq ft with 2 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, Type B of about 1,175 to 1,182 sq ft with 2+1 bedrooms, and Type C of about 1,423 sq ft with 3 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms.
- When is OAKA Residences expected to be completed? The estimated completion is 2028.
- What facilities does OAKA Residences have? Facilities include an infinity swimming pool, sky garden and rooftop lounge, a fully equipped gym and yoga studio, a half basketball court, a children's playground and a private theatre room. The development is GreenRE Gold certified, pet-friendly and equipped with EV charging infrastructure.
- Can foreign buyers purchase, and how do I arrange a viewing? Foreign buyers may purchase subject to the minimum purchase price set for Kuala Lumpur; we can confirm eligibility for the unit you have in mind. To view floor plans, the latest price list or book a showroom appointment, WhatsApp licensed negotiator Yee Woei Shyan (REN 46305, IQI Realty Sdn Bhd) at +60 10-827 8932.
